file_id: Suresh Kumar @ Anjani Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 16 January, 2012

sentences.text:
Suresh Kumar @ Anjani Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 16
January, 2012
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Patna
 Criminal Miscellaneous No.1260 of 2012
 Suresh Kumar @ Anjani Kumar
 Versus
 The State Of Bihar

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
For the petitioner: Mr. N.K. Agrawal, Sr. Advocate and Mr. Sanjiv
 Sharan, Advocate.

For the State : Mr. Madhura Nand Jha, A.P.P.
2. 16.01.2012
.
Heard learned senior counsel for the petitioner and the State.
The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in a case registered under Sections 272, 273 of the Indian Penal Code and 31, 52, 56, 57, 59, 63 and 64 of the Food Safety and Standard Act.
Some sweets (Khowa Barbhi) were seized from shop of petitioner with accusation that he has no license under the Food Alternation Act.
It is submitted by learned senior counsel for the petitioner that till date analysist report has not been received.

Considering the suspicious nature of accusation, let the petitioner, above named, be released on bail in the event of arrest or surrender before the learned court below within a period of twelve weeks from today in connection with Ram Krishna Nagar P.S. Case No. 91 of 2011 on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/-(Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned S.D.J.M., Patna, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

U. K. ( Dinesh Kumar Singh, J)
